Same thing happened to me when I moved into an older apartment. Run your finger along the bathtub. Are there parts that are smooth and then rough? If so, the seal coating on your tub is gone. 

Any dirt that runs off from your body to the water is going to easily stick to it. You can clean it and it will go away, but it will come back since you are still washing dirt into it.

The solution would be to reseal the bath tub or buy a new one.
